_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: February 27, 2026, from Capcom's reveal at Summer Game Fest 2025 (Gematsu, GamingBolt) and the Wikipedia article. Platforms are PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2, per Wikipedia. The cast, places, factions and the main twists (Victor Gideon, Zeno and the Connections, the Elpis clones, Oswell/Ozwell Spencer, ARK under Raccoon City, Emily, Sherry Birkin, the BSAA's Hound Wolf Squad sent by Chris Redfield) come from the Wikipedia plot summary and cast list. Previews and character guides (TechRadar, Push Square, GamingBolt) agree on the main cast. Weak words: Grace, Leon, Victor, Sherry, Emily, Spencer and Kennedy are common first names or surnames. Leon, Sherry and Chris also appear in other Resident Evil games. Gideon and Zeno are biblical or historical names. Requiem, Umbrella, Connections and ARK are ordinary words. Elpis is a Greek word used elsewhere. RCS and DSO are acronyms with other meanings. Raccoon City and BSAA are shared with older RE games but are kept strong, because posts about them are almost always RE spoilers. Every voice actor is weak. Left out because only one source names them: the 'Chunk' brothers boss, 'Nathan Dempsy' and the creature called 'the Girl' (that name is too generic anyway). Accounts: RE_Games is Capcom's Resident Evil account and posted the Requiem wishlist and DLC news. Capcom_Unity is left out because it posts about all of Capcom's games.
